library(readxl)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(DT)
library(bslib)

# Define UI for application that draws a histogram
ui <- fluidPage(
    
    #defines our theme which is flatly in this case
    theme = bs_theme(version = 5, bootswatch = "flatly"), 
    
    titlePanel("Statistiques de garde"),
      mainPanel(
        
        #here we define our  file inputs and an action button which keeps the rest of the application hidden until processed
        fileInput("file1", "Veuillez sélectionner le fichier Excel contenant le calendrier de gardes réalisés:", accept = ".xlsx"),
        fileInput("file2", "Veuillez sélectionner le fichier Excel contenant les jours fériés:", accept = ".xlsx"),
        actionButton("process", "Process Files"),
        br(),
        br(),
        br(),
        
        #here we add our conditional panel which will only appear once the file is processed
        conditionalPanel(
          condition = "output.fileProcessed",
        
          #now we have our three tabs one for tables, one for graphics and one for calculated remaining calls
          tabsetPanel(
            tabPanel("Distribution descriptive des gardes",
                     br(),
                     h1(textOutput("selectedDates")),
                     br(),
                     DTOutput('summary_global'),
                     br(),
                     h1('Tableau simplifié combinant les jours de semaine, les week-ends et les jours fériés'),
                     br(),
                     DTOutput('summary_reduced'),
                     ),
            
            tabPanel("Distribution des Gardes en Graphique",
                     br(),
                     h1('Représentation visuelle du nombre de garde (agrégés par jour de semaine et week-end)'),
                     br(),
                     plotOutput('bar_weekdays'),
                     br(),
                     br(),
                     plotOutput('bar_weekends'),
                     br(),
                     h4(tags$small(tags$i(textOutput('selectedDates_graphiques'))))
                     ),
            
            tabPanel("Calcul des gardes restants",
                    h1('Calcul des gardes restants en fonction de la date de fin de la prochaine période de planification à créer
                       comme sélectionnée ci-dessous'),
                    h4(tags$small(tags$i("Le calcul est effectué en calculant le nombre total de jours écoulés et en soustrayant le
                                      nombre de gardes en semaine et en week-end que chaque personne a effectués, ce qui donne le
                                      nombre de gardes que le médecin devrait effectuer au cours de la prochaine période du
                                      calendrier."))),
                    br(),
                    dateInput('Call_calculation', label = 'Date de fin du prochain planning à créer', format = "MM dd,
                              yyyy", language = "fr-CH"),
                    h1('Tableau demontrant les nombres des gardes qui doit être distribuer à chaque médecin'),
                    br(),
                    DTOutput('calls_remaining'),
                    textOutput('Remainders'),
                    br(),
                    h4(tags$small(tags$i("Si un nombre est négatif, cela signifie que la personne a effectué plus de gardes que la
                                      moyenne et que ses gardes doivent être minimisés lors de la prochaine période de garde. Notez
                                      également que, pour éviter les fractions, les gardes qui n'ont pas pu être répartis
                                      équitablement sont indiqués comme des restes sous le tableau. Ceux-ci peuvent être distribués
                                      aux personnes se situant en dessous de la moyenne."))),
                    h4(tags$small(tags$i("Les jours fériés ne sont pas inclusent dans cette tableau parce qu'ils ne sont pas assez
                                         nombreux pour mériter une distribution formelle (chaque patron va faire environs 1-2 jours
                                         fériés)"))),
                    )
              )
        )
    )
)


# Server logic
server <- function(input, output) {
  
  #first we add some lines regarding the action button and ensuring that the files are processed before tables appear
  fileProcessed <- reactiveVal(FALSE)
  
    observeEvent(input$process, {
      req(input$file1, input$file2)
      
      #data loading
      data <- as.data.frame(read_excel(input$file1$datapath))
      holidays <- as.data.frame(read_excel(input$file2$datapath))
      
      #creates the proper rowname format
      row.names(data) <- data[, 1]
      data <- data[, -1]
      
      #converts the column dates which are in string format to date-time using the lubridate package
      col_names <- colnames(data)
      date_columns <- dmy(col_names, locale = 'fr_FR')
      colnames(data) <- date_columns
      start_date <- date_columns[1]
      end_date <- tail(date_columns, n = 1)
      
      #small for loop to replace the weekend calls with the name of the weekend day
      for (i in 1:ncol(data)){
        data[, i] = gsub("08:00 - 17:00 Neuro\r\n17:00 - 08:00 Neuro" , weekdays(date_columns[i]), data[, i])
      }
      
      #another small loop to replace the weekday calls with the name of the weekday
      for (i in 1:ncol(data)){
        data[, i] = gsub("17:00 - 08:00 Neuro" , weekdays(date_columns[i]), data[, i])
      }
      
      for (i in 1:nrow(holidays)){
        holiday <- as.character(holidays[i,])
        
        if (holiday %in% colnames(data)){
          for (z in 1:nrow(data[holiday])){
            if (is.na(data[holiday][z,]) == FALSE){
              data[holiday][z,] = 'feries'
            }
          }
        }
        else {
          next
        }
      }
      
      #here we transpose our table and then convert back to factors to make it easier to parse
      data_transposed <- t(data)
      final_data <- as.data.frame(data_transposed)
      
      #here we define the levels for each factor (otherwise they would be missing some of the weekdays/weekends)
      for (i in 1:ncol(final_data)){
        final_data[,i] <- factor(final_data[,i], levels = c('lundi',  'mardi', 'mercredi', 'jeudi', 'vendredi', 
                                                            'samedi', 'dimanche', 'feries' ))
      }
      
      summary_table <- as.data.frame(lapply(final_data, summary))
      summary_table <- head(summary_table, -1)
      x =datatable(summary_table, options = list(dom = 't'))
      
      weekdays_df <- summary_table[c(1:5),]
      weekdays_df <- as.data.frame(t(colSums(weekdays_df)), row.names = 'Jours de la semaine')
      weekend_df <- summary_table[c(6,7),]
      weekend_df <- as.data.frame(t(colSums(weekend_df)), row.names = 'Jours de week-end')
      df_list <- list(weekend_df, weekdays_df, summary_table[8,])
      
      reduced_table <- as.data.frame(Reduce(function(x, y) merge(x,y, all=TRUE), df_list), row.names = c('Jours Fériés', 
                                                                                                         'Jours de week-end',
                                                                                                         'Jours de la semaine'
      ))
      
      #relevant outputs
      output$summary_global <- renderDT({
        summary_data <- as.data.frame(lapply(final_data, summary))
        summary_data <- head(summary_data, -1)
        datatable(summary_data, options = list(dom = 't'))
      })
      
      output$selectedDates <- renderText({
        paste("Gardes totales par jour entre", format(start_date, '%B %d, %Y'), "à", 
              format(end_date, '%B, %d, %Y'))
      })
      
      output$selectedDates_graphiques <- renderText({
        paste("Les tableaux ci-haut réfletent une répresentation visuelle des donnés décrits sur le premier onglet. Les donnés sont
              entre", format(start_date, '%B %d, %Y'), "et", format(end_date, '%B, %d, %Y'))
      })
      
      #here we make a simplified table which binarizes the calls into weekday and weekend
      output$summary_reduced <- renderDT({
        datatable(reduced_table, options = list(dom = 't'))
        
      })
      
      #here we have our data table which dynamically calculates the calls remaining based on the date input of the next
      #call schedule that is being created (if the date selected is the end of the year it will be the total remaning calls)
      
      output$calls_remaining <-renderDT({
        
        req(input$Call_calculation)
        
        date_seq <- seq.Date(as.Date(start_date), input$Call_calculation, by = "day")
        weekdays_count <- sum(!wday(date_seq) %in% c(1, 7))
        weekends_count <- sum(wday(date_seq) %in% c(1, 7))
        
        number_of_holidays= 0
        for (y in 1:nrow(holidays)) {
          if (sub(" UTC", "", holidays[y,]) %in% date_seq){
            number_of_holidays = number_of_holidays + 1
          }
        }
        
        weekdays_count <- weekdays_count - number_of_holidays
        
        #gives us the quotient of the number of weekdays that should be distributed to each person
        weekdays_quotient <- weekdays_count%/%ncol(reduced_table)
        weekday_remainder <- weekdays_count%%ncol(reduced_table)
        
        weekends_quotient <- weekends_count%/%ncol(reduced_table)
        weekend_remainder <- weekends_count%%ncol(reduced_table)
        
        #now we take our reduced table and remove the number of holidays from it so that it is just weekdays and weekends
        calls_remaining <- reduced_table[-1,]
        
        for (z in 1:ncol(calls_remaining)){
          calls_remaining[1,z] <- weekends_quotient - calls_remaining[1,z]
          calls_remaining[2,z] <- weekdays_quotient - calls_remaining[2,z]
        }
        
        datatable(calls_remaining, options = list(dom = 't'))
      })
      
      #here we also dyanmically calculate the calls that cannot be evenly distributed in a given time period using modulus (%%)
      output$Remainders <- renderText({
        
        req(input$Call_calculation)
        
        date_seq <- seq.Date(as.Date(start_date), input$Call_calculation, by = "day")
        weekdays_count <- sum(!wday(date_seq) %in% c(1, 7))
        weekends_count <- sum(wday(date_seq) %in% c(1, 7))
        
        number_of_holidays= 0
        for (y in 1:nrow(holidays)) {
          if (sub(" UTC", "", holidays[y,]) %in% date_seq){
            number_of_holidays = number_of_holidays + 1
          }
        }
        
        weekdays_count <- weekdays_count - number_of_holidays
        
        #gives us the quotient of the number of weekdays that should be distributed to each person
        weekdays_quotient <- weekdays_count%/%ncol(reduced_table)
        weekday_remainder <- weekdays_count%%ncol(reduced_table)
        
        weekends_quotient <- weekends_count%/%ncol(reduced_table)
        weekend_remainder <- weekends_count%%ncol(reduced_table)
        
        #now we take our reduced table and remove the number of holidays from it so that it is just weekdays and weekends
        calls_remaining <- reduced_table[-1,]
        
        for (z in 1:ncol(calls_remaining)){
          calls_remaining[1,z] <- weekends_quotient - calls_remaining[1,z]
          calls_remaining[2,z] <- weekdays_quotient - calls_remaining[2,z]
        }
        
        paste("Il y a ", weekday_remainder, " jours de la semaine et ", weekend_remainder, " jours du weekend qui ne pouvaient
              pas être répartie de manière égale entre le nombre de médecins.")  
      })
      
      #our weekday graphic
      output$bar_weekdays <- renderPlot({
        
        weekdays_bar = as.data.frame(t(reduced_table))
        
        ggplot(weekdays_bar, aes(x = rownames(weekdays_bar), y = weekdays_bar[,3])) +
          geom_bar(stat = 'identity', fill = 'lightblue') +
          labs(title = "Nombre de gardes de la semaine effectués par chaque neuroradiologue",
               x = "Neuroradiologues", y = "Fréquence") +
          geom_text(aes(label = weekdays_bar[,3]), vjust = -0.5, size = 5) +
          theme_minimal() +
          theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 24),
                axis.title = element_text(face = "italic", size = 20),
                axis.title.x = element_text(vjust = -0.4),
                axis.title.y = element_text(vjust = 2),
                axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
                axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
                strip.text = element_text(size = 16, face = 'bold', color = 'white'),
                legend.position = "none")+
          ylim(0,as.integer((max(reduced_table[3,])+2)))
      })
      
      #our weekend graphic
      output$bar_weekends <- renderPlot({
        
        weekends_bar = as.data.frame(t(reduced_table))
        
        ggplot(weekends_bar, aes(x = rownames(weekends_bar), y = weekends_bar[,2])) +
          geom_bar(stat = 'identity', fill = 'lightblue') +
          labs(title = "Nombre de gardes de weekend effectués par chaque neuroradiologue",
               x = "Neuroradiologues", y = "Fréquence") +
          geom_text(aes(label = weekends_bar[,2]), vjust = -0.5, size = 5) +
          theme_minimal() +
          theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 24),
                axis.title = element_text(face = "italic", size = 20),
                axis.title.x = element_text(vjust = -0.4),
                axis.title.y = element_text(vjust = 2),
                axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
                axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
                strip.text = element_text(size = 16, face = 'bold', color = 'white'),
                legend.position = "none")+
          ylim(0,as.integer((max(reduced_table[2,])+2)))
      })
    
    #this line here ensures that none of these things are displayed until they are calculated  
    fileProcessed(TRUE)
    
    })
  
    #this line here ensures that none of these things are displayed until they are calculated      
  output$fileProcessed <- reactive({
      fileProcessed()
  })
  
  outputOptions(output, "fileProcessed", suspendWhenHidden = FALSE)
}

# Run the application 
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
